turns.utterance: Please complete the following visual checks. First, inspect the rod surface for scoring, pitting, or corrosion along the full stroke. Then check the rod seal and wiper for extrusion or deformation. Finally, inspect the cylinder end caps and port fittings for any leakage.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the rod surface for scoring, pitting, or corrosion along full stroke. 2. Check the rod seal and wiper for extrusion or deformation. 3. Inspect the cylinder end caps and port fittings for leakage.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Visual inspection complete. The rod surface looks clean with no scoring or corrosion. The seals and wipers appear intact with no deformation, and I don't see any leakage at the end caps or fittings.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the rod surface for scoring, pitting, or corrosion along full stroke. 2. Check the rod seal and wiper for extrusion or deformation. 3. Inspect the cylinder end caps and port fittings for leakage.

turns.utterance: Rod scoring, buckling or seal extrusion visible?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No visible damage. The rod and seals both look good.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Supply pressure within specified range?

ground_truth.node_text: Supply pressure within specified range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the supply pressure is reading within the specified range on both extension and retraction strokes.

ground_truth.node_text: Supply pressure within specified range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Pressure decay within 0.05 bar per minute limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Pressure decay within 0.05 bar per minute limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing a decay rate of about 0.12 bar per minute on the cap side. That's above the acceptable limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Pressure decay within 0.05 bar per minute limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please repack the rod seal and replace all O-rings.

ground_truth.node_text: Repack rod seal and replace O rings

turns.utterance: Rod seal repacked and O-rings replaced. The cylinder is reassembled and repressurized.

ground_truth.node_text: Repack rod seal and replace O rings

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify leak down after seal repacking.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify leak down after seal repacking

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Leak down test is now passing. Pressure decay is within acceptable limits on both sides.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify leak down after seal repacking

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Stroke length within plus or minus 0.5 millimeters of nominal?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, measured stroke is within tolerance. It's matching the nominal stroke on the datasheet.

ground_truth.node_text: Stroke length within ±0.5 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Deceleration cushion distance within spec?

ground_truth.node_text: Deceleration cushion distance within spec?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the cushion profile looks good. Deceleration is smooth with no impact or bounce at end of stroke on both directions.

ground_truth.node_text: Deceleration cushion distance within spec?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Extend and retract times within specified range?

ground_truth.node_text: Extend and retract times within specified range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the cycle times are running about twenty percent slower than the target specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Extend and retract times within specified range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the flow control valves, both directions independently.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust flow control valves, both directions independently

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Flow control valves adjusted. I've opened them up to increase the speed on both extension and retraction.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust flow control valves, both directions independently

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Move the cylinder to its fully extended position and verify that the extension proximity switch indicator light is on. Then retract the cylinder fully and confirm the retract proximity switch activates. Use a digital caliper to measure the gap between the sensor face and the trigger flag at each position.

ground_truth.node_text: Move the cylinder to its fully extended position and verify that the extension proximity switch indicator light is on. Retract the cylinder fully and confirm the retract proximity switch activates. Use a digital caliper to measure the gap between the sensor face and the trigger flag at each position and compare against the sensor manufacturer's rated sensing distance.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The extension light comes on fine, but I'm noticing the cylinder is making a grinding noise during the last inch of travel that wasn't there before.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Position sensors checked. Both switches are triggering correctly and the measured gaps are within the sensor's rated sensing distance.

ground_truth.node_text: Move the cylinder to its fully extended position and verify that the extension proximity switch indicator light is on. Retract the cylinder fully and confirm the retract proximity switch activates. turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: End position sensors trigger at correct rod positions?

ground_truth.node_text: End position sensors trigger at correct rod positions?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both sensors are triggering at the correct positions with proper indicator lights.

ground_truth.node_text: End position sensors trigger at correct rod positions?

turns.utterance: Run a cycling endurance test for 100 consecutive cycles.

turns.utterance: Endurance test complete. I've run the full 100 cycles.

ground_truth.node_text: Cycling endurance test, 100 consecutive cycles

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: No leaks, correct stroke or timing faults after 100 cycles?

ground_truth.node_text: No leaks, correct stroke or timing faults after 100 cycles?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing a small leak developing at the rod seal after about 80 cycles. There's visible misting on the retraction stroke.

ground_truth.node_text: No leaks, correct stroke or timing faults after 100 cycles?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Investigate the fault symptom and repeat the relevant section.

ground_truth.node_text: Investigate fault symptom and repeat relevant section

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've identified the issue. The rod seal wasn't fully seated during the earlier repack. I've corrected it and the leak has stopped.

ground_truth.node_text: Investigate fault symptom and repeat relevant section

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log all measurements and update the pneumatics maintenance record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all measurements and update pneumatics maintenance record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All measurements logged and maintenance record updated in the system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all measurements and update pneumatics maintenance record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The cylinder has passed all diagnostic checks and is ready to return to service.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood. Cylinder is cleared for production.
